headline_marked: [[4 police stations and 6 investigation centers]] to be set up in Purbachal
headline: 4 police stations and 6 investigation centers to be set up in Purbachal
summary: The DMP has officially started operations in the Purbachal New Town project with the inauguration of the Barkau Police Camp.
details: Inspector General of Police (IGP) Md. Ali Hossain Fakir inaugurated the 'Barkau Police Camp' in Sector-1 of the Purbachal New Town project on Wednesday.

As part of the security plan, the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) will establish four police stations, six investigation centers, two police lines, and three Deputy Commissioner (DC) offices in the area.
Additionally, 41 police boxes are being set up across various sectors to ensure the safety and security of the planned modern city.

The Ministry of Home Affairs has already provided administrative approval for these facilities. RAJUK has allocated 29.21 acres of land for the Bangladesh Police, with registration for 18.63 acres already completed.
The IGP announced that Purbachal will eventually be brought fully under the DMP's jurisdiction, forming a separate division led by an Additional Police Commissioner.
A proposal to create approximately 6,524 new personnel positions to manage the security of the new town is currently under consideration.
Two police camps are planned for the initial phase. While the Barkau camp is now open, another camp in the proposed Pashi police station area is expected to be inaugurated within two months.
caption:
Purbachal is getting a massive security upgrade. 4 police stations and 41 police boxes are coming to the new town!

Inspector General of Police (IGP) Md. Ali Hossain Fakir inaugurated the 'Barkau Police Camp' in Sector-1 of the Purbachal New Town project on Wednesday.

As part of the security plan, the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) will establish four police stations, six investigation centers, two police lines, and three Deputy Commissioner (DC) offices in the area.

Additionally, 41 police boxes are being set up across various sectors to ensure the safety and security of the planned modern city.

The Ministry of Home Affairs has already provided administrative approval for these facilities. RAJUK has allocated 29.21 acres of land for the Bangladesh Police, with registration for 18.63 acres already completed.

The IGP announced that Purbachal will eventually be brought fully under the DMP's jurisdiction, forming a separate division led by an Additional Police Commissioner.

A proposal to create approximately 6,524 new personnel positions to manage the security of the new town is currently under consideration.

Two police camps are planned for the initial phase. While the Barkau camp is now open, another camp in the proposed Pashi police station area is expected to be inaugurated within two months.

#Bangladesh #Purbachal #Dhaka #DMP #Security #UrbanDevelopment

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, Somoy News
